def test_all_three_authenticated_helpers_capture_and_observe_same_local_store(self):
        ids = []
        for number, host in enumerate(self.hosts):
            result, registered = self.cli(host, "register", {"candidates": [self.offer(number)]})
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr + result.stdout)
            self.assertTrue(registered["durable"])
            ids.append(registered["items"][0]["obligation_id"])
        for host in self.hosts:
            result, observed = self.cli(host, "scan")
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr + result.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(observed["status"], "complete")
            self.assertEqual([item["obligation_id"] for item in observed["items"]], ids)
            self.assertLessEqual(observed["bytes_read"], 262144)
        self.assertEqual((self.root / ".codearbiter/open-tasks.md").read_text(), "# Tasks\n\n## Backlog\n")
observations.finite_assertion: Each authenticated host durably registers; all three observe exact ordered IDs with <=256KiB; legacy board unchanged.

def test_real_native_work_effect_is_reconciled_after_actual_process_death(self):
        (self.root / ".codearbiter/open-tasks.md").unlink()
        _, registration = self.cli("codex", "register", {"candidates": [self.offer()]})
        self.assertTrue(registration["durable"], registration)
        oid = registration["items"][0]["obligation_id"]
        script = ("import sys,json,os;sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]);import _workflowrecoverylib as r;"
                  "\ndef crash(point):\n if point=='after-target':os._exit(79)\n"
                  "r.dispatch(sys.argv[2],'resume',{'obligation_id':sys.argv[3],'expected_revision':1},fault=crash)\n")
        process = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-c", script, str(self.hosts["codex"] / "hooks"), str(self.root), oid],
                                 env=self.environment("codex"), cwd=self.root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        self.assertEqual(process.returncode, 79, process.stderr + process.stdout)
        work = self.root / ".codearbiter/work"
        files = {path.name: path.read_bytes() for path in work.glob("*.html")}
        self.assertEqual(len(files), 1)
        _, record = self.cli("pi", "get", oid=oid)
        self.assertEqual(record["record"]["state"], "claimed")
        result, reconciled = self.cli("pi", "reconcile", oid=oid, revision=record["record"]["record_revision"])
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr + result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(reconciled["status"], "settled", reconciled)
        self.assertEqual(reconciled["record"]["effect"]["owner"], "native-work")
        self.assertEqual(files, {path.name: path.read_bytes() for path in work.glob("*.html")})
        self.assertFalse((self.root / ".codearbiter/open-tasks.md").exists())
observations.finite_assertion: Actual os._exit(79) after native work effect; exactly one HTML target; claimed record; Pi reconciliation settles native-work with identical target bytes and no legacy board.

def test_unknown_helper_foreign_manifest_and_arbitrary_storage_argument_refuse(self):

        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)

def test_automatic_scan_child_environment_has_no_provider_credentials(self):
        _, registered = self.cli("pi", "register", {"candidates": [self.offer()]})
        self.assertTrue(registered["durable"])
        script = ("import sys,json;sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]);import _workflowrecoverylib as r;"
                  "real=r.subprocess.run\ndef observe(*args,**kw):\n"
                  " assert 'FARM_API_KEY' not in kw['env']\n assert 'CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN' not in kw['env']\n"
                  " assert 'PYTHONPATH' not in kw['env']\n return real(*args,**kw)\n"
                  "r.subprocess.run=observe;print(json.dumps(r.automatic_snapshot(sys.argv[2])))\n")
        env = self.environment("pi")
        env["FARM_API_KEY"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
        env["CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
        process = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-c", script, str(self.hosts["pi"] / "hooks"), str(self.root)],
                                 env=env, cwd=self.root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
        self.assertEqual(process.returncode, 0, process.stderr)
        observed = json.loads(process.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(observed["status"], "complete", observed)
        self.assertEqual(observed["pending"], 1)
observations.finite_assertion: Probe asserts child env excludes FARM_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, PYTHONPATH; actual automatic snapshot completes.

def test_changed_native_project_and_dual_owner_hold_only_affected_obligation(self):
        board = self.root / ".codearbiter/open-tasks.md"
        board.unlink()
        _, initial = self.cli("claude", "register", {"candidates": [self.offer()]})
        oid = initial["items"][0]["obligation_id"]
        _, promoted = self.cli("claude", "resume", oid=oid, revision=1)
        self.assertEqual(promoted["status"], "settled", promoted)
        _, pending = self.cli("codex", "register", {"candidates": [self.offer(1)]})
        other = pending["items"][0]["obligation_id"]
        project = self.root / ".codearbiter/work/project.json"
        original = project.read_bytes()
        changed = json.loads(original)
        changed["project_id"] = "PROJECT-" + "A" * 32
        project.write_text(json.dumps(changed))
        before = {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in project.parent.glob("*.html")}
        _, held = self.cli("codex", "resume", oid=other, revision=1)
        self.assertEqual(held["reason"], "changed-binding", held)
        self.assertEqual(before, {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in project.parent.glob("*.html")})
        project.write_bytes(original)
        board.write_text("# Legacy owner\n\n## Backlog\n")
        _, another = self.cli("pi", "register", {"candidates": [self.offer(2)]})
        third = another["items"][0]["obligation_id"]
        _, ambiguous = self.cli("pi", "resume", oid=third, revision=1)
        self.assertEqual(ambiguous["reason"], "owner-ambiguous", ambiguous)
        self.assertEqual(board.read_text(), "# Legacy owner\n\n## Backlog\n")
        self.assertEqual(before, {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in project.parent.glob("*.html")})
observations.finite_assertion: Changed project ID refuses changed-binding; restored native + legacy dual owner refuses owner-ambiguous; existing HTML and board bytes unchanged.

def test_real_startup_prompt_and_compaction_keep_notice_separate_from_persona(self):
        self.register()
        baseline = self.store_snapshot()
        for index, host in enumerate(("claude", "codex")):
            with self.subTest(host=host):
                session = "notice-session-" + host
                payload = {"hook_event_name": "SessionStart", "cwd": str(self.root), "session_id": session}
                started = time.monotonic()
                first = self.script(host, "session-start.py", payload, startup=True)
                elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
                self.assertEqual(first.returncode, 0, first.stderr)
                self.assertIn(f"workflow recovery page: {index + 1} pending", first.stdout)
                self.assertLess(elapsed, 60)  # Actual Codex startup hook budget.
                repeated = self.script(host, "session-start.py", payload, startup=True)
                self.assertEqual(repeated.returncode, 0, repeated.stderr)
                self.assertNotIn("workflow recovery page:", repeated.stdout)
                prompt = {"hook_event_name": "UserPromptSubmit", "cwd": str(self.root), "session_id": session, "prompt": "continue"}
                first_prompt = self.script(host, "prompt-submit.py", prompt)
                self.assertEqual(first_prompt.returncode, 0, first_prompt.stderr)
                self.assertNotIn("codeArbiter: workflow recovery page:", first_prompt.stdout)
                self.register(1 if host == "claude" else 2)
                changed = self.script(host, "prompt-submit.py", prompt)
                self.assertEqual(changed.returncode, 0, changed.stderr)
                self.assertIn("codeArbiter: workflow recovery page:", changed.stdout)
                if host == "codex":
                    self.assertIn("workflow recovery page:", json.loads(changed.stdout)["hookSpecificOutput"]["additionalContext"])
                compact = dict(prompt, hook_event_name="PreCompact")
                self.assertEqual(self.script(host, "prompt-submit.py", compact).returncode, 0)
                after_compact = self.script(host, "prompt-submit.py", prompt)
                self.assertEqual(after_compact.returncode, 0, after_compact.stderr)
                self.assertNotIn("codeArbiter: workflow recovery page:", after_compact.stdout)
        # Registration above is the only ledger writer. Presentation never
        # marks any record settled or calls a work target.
        _, observed = self.cli("pi", "scan")
        self.assertEqual({item["state"] for item in observed["items"]}, {"pending"})
        self.assertEqual((self.root / ".codearbiter/open-tasks.md").read_text(), "# Tasks\n\n## Backlog\n")
        self.assertTrue(set(baseline).issubset(self.store_snapshot()))
        after = self.store_snapshot()
        for path, raw in baseline.items():
            if path != "index.json" and not path.startswith("pages/"):
                self.assertEqual(after[path], raw)
observations.finite_assertion: Real Claude/Codex startup/prompt/PreCompact event seams suppress repeats, emit changed pending count; records remain pending and board unchanged. Only unrelated background fetch/update launchers doubled.

def test_codex_pretool_context_does_not_synthesize_allow_or_change_block(self):
        self.register()
        before = self.store_snapshot()
        allowed = {"hook_event_name": "PreToolUse", "tool_name": "exec_command", "cwd": str(self.root),
                   "session_id": "allowed-notice", "tool_input": {"command": "git status --short"}}
        observed = self.script("codex", "pre-tool-adapter.py", allowed)
        self.assertEqual(observed.returncode, 0, observed.stderr)
        body = json.loads(observed.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn("decision", body)
        self.assertNotIn("permissionDecision", body["hookSpecificOutput"])
        self.assertIn("workflow recovery page:", body["hookSpecificOutput"]["additionalContext"])
        blocked = dict(allowed, session_id="blocked-notice", tool_input={"command": "git commit -m blocked-probe"})
        rejected = self.script("codex", "pre-tool-adapter.py", blocked)
        self.assertEqual(rejected.returncode, 0, rejected.stderr)
        body = json.loads(rejected.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(body["decision"], "block")
        self.assertNotIn("hookSpecificOutput", body)
        self.assertEqual(before, self.store_snapshot())
observations.finite_assertion: Allowed exec gets recovery additionalContext with no permission allow; blocked commit stays block without hookSpecificOutput; store identical.

def test_pi_closed_snapshot_codec_reads_pending_state_without_any_effect(self):
        oid = self.register()
        before = self.store_snapshot()
        request = {"version": 1, "event": "workflow_recovery_snapshot", "cwd": str(self.root), "sessionId": "new-parent-session"}
        result = self.script("pi", "pi-bridge.py", request)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        value = json.loads(result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(value["auditCode"], "PI_WORKFLOW_RECOVERY")
        snapshot = value["resultPatch"]["workflowRecovery"]
        self.assertEqual(set(snapshot), {"status", "revision", "pending", "claimed", "unavailable", "cursor",
                                         "bytesRead", "reason", "notice", "fingerprint"})
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["pending"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["claimed"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["status"], "complete")
        self.assertNotIn("grant", snapshot)
        self.assertNotIn(oid, snapshot["notice"])
        self.assertEqual(before, self.store_snapshot())
observations.finite_assertion: Pi Python bridge event returns exact closed snapshot key set, pending1/claimed0/complete; no grant or obligation ID in notice; store identical.
Absent and disabled Pi snapshot returns absent/empty notice without ledger or marker directories.

def test_corrupt_inventory_notice_never_repairs_or_blocks_real_host_entry(self):
        self.register()
        index = self.root / ".git/codearbiter/workflow-recovery/v1/index.json"
        index.write_bytes(b"not valid JSON\n")
        before = self.store_snapshot()
        for host in ("claude", "codex"):
            result = self.script(host, "session-start.py", {"hook_event_name": "SessionStart", "cwd": str(self.root),
                                                            "session_id": "damaged-" + host}, startup=True)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            self.assertIn("workflow recovery inventory unavailable", result.stdout)
            self.assertIn("Independent authorized work continues", result.stdout)
        result = self.script("pi", "pi-bridge.py", {"version": 1, "event": "workflow_recovery_snapshot", "cwd": str(self.root)})
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        value = json.loads(result.stdout)["resultPatch"]["workflowRecovery"]
        self.assertEqual(value["status"], "unavailable")
        self.assertIn("Independent authorized work continues", value["notice"])
        self.assertEqual(before, self.store_snapshot())
observations.finite_assertion: Actual corrupt index remains byte-identical; Claude/Codex startup and Pi bridge report unavailable/independent work continues, exit0.
